title: ClientSt0r
subtitle: Self-hosted IT documentation and service desk for MSPs — client assets, runbooks, an encrypted credential vault and native ticketing, all on your own infrastructure.

caption_html: One tenant per client. Open a customer and everything — assets, documents, credentials, tickets — is scoped to them.
caption_text: One tenant per client. Open a customer and everything is scoped to them.

scrolls.caption_html: The week ahead. Scheduled tickets and maintenance falling due, merged into one list.
scrolls.caption_text: The week ahead. Scheduled tickets and maintenance falling due, merged into one list.

scrolls.caption_html: Monitor status and the client's sites sit underneath, as reference rather than headline.
scrolls.caption_text: Monitor status and the client's sites sit underneath, as reference rather than headline.

caption_html: The customer record. Contacts, addresses, sites, and shortcuts into their VoIP, email, Microsoft 365 and firewall documentation.
caption_text: The customer record. Contacts, addresses, sites, and shortcuts into their documentation.

caption_html: A service desk you own, not one you rent. Every client in one queue, filtered by status, priority, queue or technician.
caption_text: A service desk you own, not one you rent. Every client in one queue.

caption_html: A ticket that already knows the customer. Their active contract and hours used, and the SLA countdown, without leaving the page.
caption_text: A ticket that already knows the customer — active contract, hours used, and the SLA countdown.

scrolls.caption_html: Internal notes stay internal. Client-visible replies are kept visibly separate, so nothing leaks by accident.
scrolls.caption_text: Internal notes stay internal. Client-visible replies are kept visibly separate.

scrolls.caption_html: The credentials this job needs — by title and username only. Secrets are never rendered here; opening one is permissioned and audited.
scrolls.caption_text: The credentials this job needs, by title and username only. Secrets are never rendered here.

caption_html: The runbook lives beside the work — written for the technician who will run it, and linked from the ticket that needed it.
caption_text: The runbook lives beside the work, linked from the ticket that needed it.

caption_html: Per-client documentation and a shared knowledge base, searchable across titles and body text.
caption_text: Per-client documentation and a shared knowledge base, searchable across titles and body text.

caption_html: Light or dark, per person. Twelve themes ship, and every screen honours the one you pick.
caption_text: Light or dark, per person. Twelve themes ship, and every screen honours the one you pick.

caption_html: The asset record. Identity, network, operating system, hardware, rack position, warranty and lifecycle — on one page.
caption_text: The asset record: identity, network, OS, hardware, rack position, warranty and lifecycle.

scrolls.caption_html: Lifecycle and warranty dates mean the refresh conversation happens before the hardware fails.
scrolls.caption_text: Lifecycle and warranty dates mean the refresh conversation happens before the hardware fails.

caption_html: What is physically in the comms room — every device at its U position, linked back to its asset record.
caption_text: What is physically in the comms room — every device at its U position, linked to its asset record.

caption_html: Address space per client — subnets with their VLAN, gateway and DNS, and which addresses are free.
caption_text: Address space per client: subnets with VLAN, gateway and DNS, and which addresses are free.

caption_html: The vault. AES-GCM encrypted at rest, organised per client, with per-entry access rules and audited reveals.
caption_text: The vault: AES-GCM encrypted at rest, per-entry access rules, audited reveals.

caption_html: Dispatch the week. Drag a ticket onto a technician's row; anything close to breaching its SLA surfaces at the top.
caption_text: Dispatch the week. Drag a ticket onto a technician's row; SLA risk surfaces at the top.

caption_html: Recurring maintenance runs on its own schedule, with per-task sign-off, separate from the ticket queue.
caption_text: Recurring maintenance runs on its own schedule, with per-task sign-off.

caption_html: Projects with real dependencies. Drag a bar to reschedule; work that is blocked says so, and by what.
caption_text: Projects with real dependencies. Drag a bar to reschedule; blocked work says so, and by what.

scrolls.caption_html: The dependency table underneath is where the blocking relationships are actually edited.
scrolls.caption_text: The dependency table underneath is where the blocking relationships are edited.

caption_html: Back to light for the commercial side. Draft, sent and accepted quotes across every client.
caption_text: Back to light for the commercial side. Draft, sent and accepted quotes across every client.

caption_html: Quote to signature. A PDF, an email, and a signing link the customer uses without an account. Accepting it can open a ticket or spin up a project.
caption_text: Quote to signature: a PDF, an email, and a signing link the customer uses without an account.

caption_html: Every invoice line carries its origin — a contract period, a logged time entry, an expense — so a billing query is answerable.
caption_text: Every invoice line carries its origin, so a billing query is answerable without reconstructing it.

caption_html: Agreements track themselves. Block hours with rollover, auto-renewal, and a profitability snapshot for the period.
caption_text: Agreements track themselves: block hours with rollover, auto-renewal, and a profitability snapshot.

caption_html: Revenue against cost of delivery, per client — drawn from the time already logged and the invoices already issued.
caption_text: Revenue against cost of delivery, per client, drawn from logged time and issued invoices.

caption_html: Client health combines SLA performance, ticket velocity, billing aging and engagement, so at-risk accounts surface early.
caption_text: Client health combines SLA performance, ticket velocity, billing aging and engagement.

caption_html: And the whole book of business — every tenant, every site, on one page.
caption_text: And the whole book of business: every tenant, every site, on one page.

caption_html: Modules are opt-in. The service desk, AI assistance and the rest stay off until an administrator turns them on.
